# Material Icons

Copyright Google LLC. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (see LICENSE).

The toolbar icons use the Material Icons 24px `archive`, `done_all`, `filter_list`,
and `content_copy` paths, converted from SVG to Android VectorDrawable paths.
Response archive menu icons use the Material Icons 24px `history` and `save` paths.

Source: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons
